baseline_models.mechanism: The breadth and increase of بسط oppose the deliberate reduction of قدر, while رزق names a divided allotment. The pair depicts active resizing of an assigned benefit rather than two unrelated outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Breadth, increase, and surplus make بسط the widening pole of the allocation mechanism.
Reduction to a small measure makes قدر the narrowing pole opposed to expansion.
A divided gift or benefit supplies the object whose accessible measure is widened or narrowed.

changed_reading.before: God gives some recipients more provision and others less.
changed_reading.after: God actively opens an allotted field of benefit or narrows it to a measured span for a recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِمَن يَشَآءُ ... إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The مشيئة branch binds willing to a thing, كل encloses all parts, and علم presents apprehended disclosure. The allocation is object-specific and exhaustively known, not an impersonal fluctuation.

activation_trace.role: Volition related to a thing links the chosen recipient and the concluding 'thing' under one intentional frame.
Enclosure and totality make the final knowledge claim comprehensive rather than generic.
Known disclosure supplies the epistemic ground surrounding each differential measure.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports unrestricted sovereign choice.
changed_reading.after: Each widening or narrowing is presented as a particular willing enclosed by exhaustive knowledge of every relevant thing.

baseline_models.mechanism: عباد activates obedient service, the divine name activates the worshipped source, and رزق remains an assigned gift. Distribution therefore occurs inside a worship relation, not as an anonymous transfer between detached economic actors.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship makes the recipients servants whose relation to the giver matters alongside quantity.
The worshipped one frames both the opening action and the closing knowledge claim as one source's governance.
The allotted gift is the material term carried inside that servant-source relation.

changed_reading.before: People are recipients of unequal amounts.
changed_reading.after: Widening and narrowing are relational acts toward servants of the one worshipped, not anonymous movements of wealth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening repeatedly casts human conditions as an assay that makes truthfulness and falsehood knowable. Read back into the focus, expanded and restricted provision can be distinct testing conditions under the closing علم clause, rather than transparent rewards and punishments.

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies the assay image for conditions that expose a response.
The repeated assay establishes testing as a sustained surah-level mechanism rather than an isolated hardship.
Disclosure to knowledge links the assay to the focus verse's concluding omniscience.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 place repeated testing before a paired disclosure of the truthful and the false, while 29:62 closes differential provision with علم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, differentiated responses, and knowledge; I infer that breadth and restriction may function as differing assay conditions. A live alternative is that testing governs the surah generally while 29:62 only describes provision.

changed_reading.before: Breadth signals favor and restriction signals disfavor.
changed_reading.after: Either breadth or restriction may be an assay condition whose significance lies partly in the servant's disclosed response, so quantity alone does not reveal moral rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: 29:17 denies other worshipped objects any ownership or disposal of provision, then directs seeking, worship, and gratitude to God. This sharpens 29:62 into source discrimination: changing amounts never transfer providential authority to a rival source.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and power of disposal are explicitly denied to alternative objects of worship, isolating the true source.
The allotted gift appears first as what rivals cannot control and then as what must be sought with God.
Active seeking gives the recipient a role without converting effort into ultimate ownership of the outcome.
Recognition of the benefit and its giver supplies the response appropriate to provision.
Repeated worship and obedience connect the focus's 'His servants' to allegiance toward the provider.

structural_cues: 29:17 repeats provision inside a denial-command sequence: rivals do not own it; seek it with God; worship Him; give thanks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied rival ownership and commanded seeking, worship, and thanks; I infer that 29:62 stabilizes allegiance across changing amounts. Alternatively, 29:17 may polemicize idolatry without specifying why individual shares differ.

changed_reading.before: Differential provision is simply a fact about unequal shares.
changed_reading.after: Whatever the share, provision tests recognition of its source: neither abundance nor scarcity licenses a competing master, and seeking remains paired with worship and thanks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same servant root appears where God's earth is declared wide and worship is commanded; patience and reliance then precede the provision sequence. This spatializes بسط: an apparently narrow channel in one place need not exhaust the wider field through which provision may open.

activation_trace.role: Servanthood and worship identify the mobile addressees as the same relational class named in the focus.
Spatial openness contrary to constriction supplies a geographic analogue for the focus's expansion.
Holding oneself from panic supplies the posture needed while a current channel remains narrow.
Reliance supplies the relational means of moving without treating stored resources as the sole guarantor.

structural_cues: 29:56 joins servants, a wide earth, and worship; 29:59 places patience and reliance immediately before the creature-provision example and 29:62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wide earth, servants, patience, and reliance; I infer that relocation can mediate an opening of provision. The live alternative is that expansion occurs independently of movement and the wide-earth cue concerns worship alone.

changed_reading.before: The recipient passively waits within a fixed local allotment.
changed_reading.after: A locally restricted channel need not mean provision is closed altogether; for servants able to move across a wide earth, reliance and movement may participate in its opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding creature example negates carrying provision while affirming repeated divine provisioning and knowledge. This converts رزق from stock owned in reserve into a renewed relation of access; بسط and قدر can regulate flow without implying abandonment when inventory is absent.

activation_trace.role: Literal lifting or carrying of a visible load is negated, removing stored possession as the necessary form of security.
The allotted benefit is both named and actively supplied, turning a noun-like stock into a continuing giver-recipient relation.
Knowledge closes the non-carrying example and directly anticipates the focus's epistemic assurance.

structural_cues: 29:60 says a creature does not carry its provision, then places 'God provides it and you' beside hearing and knowing immediately before 29:62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-carriage, active provisioning, and knowledge; I infer recurring access rather than possessed inventory. A narrower alternative is that the example only observes that many creatures do not store food.

changed_reading.before: Expansion and restriction describe how much provision a recipient possesses.
changed_reading.after: They can describe the width of an ongoing supply relation: provision may arrive without being carried or stored, and a narrowed flow is not the same as absence of care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The رزق inventory itself contains rain as provision, and the next ayah realizes a chain of descent, conveyed water, and revived earth. Expansion thus becomes ecological throughput that propagates life, while restriction can be read as reduced throughput rather than only a smaller cash-like quantity.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending as provision supplies the focus-side latent bridge from allotment to hydrology.
Bringing down and conveying supplies the delivery stage of the provision mechanism.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the mobile medium through which benefit spreads.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the conversion of delivered provision into living productivity.

structural_cues: 29:63 follows the focus immediately and forms a causal-looking sequence from descent to water to earth revived after death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-provision, delivered water, and revived earth; I supply the throughput arrow linking those stages to بسط. The alternative is that 29:63 exemplifies divine power and gratitude without defining the expansion-restriction pair.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a static amount of money or food assigned to an individual.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be a transmitted life process: water descends, spreads through earth, and becomes renewed productivity, so expansion names reach and conversion as well as quantity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel calls present life distraction and unserious play, then calls what was given an enjoyed benefit followed by future knowing. This blocks reading broad provision as permanent ownership or final valuation; it is usable but temporally bounded.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied away from what matters marks worldly use as capable of diverting attention from ultimate value.
Action without a serious final aim prevents present abundance from serving as the final score.
The unrealized human knowing contrasts with the focus's already exhaustive divine knowledge.
A benefit that is enjoyed supplies a usufruct image: real use without a claim of permanent possession or rank.

structural_cues: 29:64 contrasts present life with the enduring life, and 29:66 places enjoyment of what was given before future knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, play, enjoyed benefit, and delayed human knowing; I infer that expanded provision is temporary use rather than final valuation. Alternatively, the warning may concern misuse of provision rather than its tenure.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision is a durable gain and evidence of settled favor.
changed_reading.after: Expanded provision is a temporally bounded benefit for use; its abundance does not settle ultimate life, ownership, or moral standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare livestock branch of بسط beside a crawling creature and negated carrying, rather than using the ordinary wealth sense. It remains anchored to the focus verb and the adjacent animal-provision example. Render it only as an exploratory access analogy, not as a replacement translation of يَبْسُطُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ, activated beside 29:60's creature that does not carry provision

activation_trace.role: The she-camel left unrestricted with her young contributes a literal release-from-restraint image and makes unblocked access the proposed mode of expansion.
A creature creeping on earth supplies the adjacent animal ecology that activates the livestock image.
Negated carrying of a visible load shifts security away from stock and toward access while moving.
Contraction to a small measure supplies the counterpole against which released access counts as expansion.

changed_reading.before: To expand provision is only to increase the recipient's stock.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, expansion may also mean removing restraints and opening access, as when a dependent creature is left free to reach what sustains it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the cooking-vessel sense of قدر is not the ordinary constriction sense required by the syntax. It remains visibly anchored to يَقْدِرُ and food-like رزق and preserves a material analogy for measured allotment. Downstream prose should label it a pot-and-portion image, never a lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: The cooking pot contributes a bounded vessel in which an undifferentiated supply becomes a prepared portion.
Food entering the body supplies the material content portioned by the vessel analogy.

changed_reading.before: Restriction is an abstract reduction in amount.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, provision is portioned through a finite vessel: what reaches a servant is measured and prepared, not merely subtracted from an unlimited pile.

strongest_changes: Provision shifted from possessed stock to a renewed flow that need not be carried.
Expansion and restriction became possible assay conditions rather than readable badges of moral rank.
Wide earth and reliance made provision spatially mobile, while the rain sequence made it ecological throughput.
Worldly abundance became temporary usable benefit rather than permanent ownership or final valuation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context linked the focus's metering verbs to testing, worship, migration, animal dependence, hydrology, and temporality without collapsing those mechanisms into one reading. The rare released-camel branch preserved an access-not-volume possibility.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not state that relocation causes expansion; that directional link remains abductive.
The testing frame may govern servant response generally rather than explain each differential allotment.
The livestock-release and cooking-vessel images are branch-distant analogies, not proposed lexical substitutions.
